description: This file contains the implementation of a deterministic finite automaton (DFA) as part of a parser or lexer, including transition tables, prediction logic, and debugging facilities.

classes.name: DFA
classes.description: A class representing a deterministic finite automaton used for syntactic prediction in parsing.

methods.name: predict
methods.description: Predicts the successful alternative based on input, managing state and exception handling.

methods.name: _predict
methods.description: Internal method implementing the DFA transition and acceptance logic, returning the predicted alternative.

methods.name: noViableAlt
methods.description: Handles situations where no acceptable transition is found, throwing an exception or setting failure state.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Hook method for debugging errors; can be overridden for custom error handling.

methods.name: specialStateTransition
methods.description: Placeholder method for handling special states; meant to be overridden if needed.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns a textual description of the DFA, defaulting to 'n/a'.

methods.name: unpackEncodedString
methods.description: Static method converting run-length-encoded string to an array of shorts.
